title: Implement Comparison section variant (comparison-table)
description: Implement a Comparison section showing a side-by-side comparison table (e.g., 'Us vs Competitors', or tiered service comparison).
acceptanceCriteria: Accepts `{ content: ComparisonContent, business: BusinessInfo }` props
Renders comparison columns with labels and feature checkmarks/crosses
First column (business name) is visually highlighted
Verify in browser with Playwright screenshot

steps.details: Headline + responsive table. Column headers (from content.columns[].label). Feature rows (features from the first column drive the rows). Checkmark (✓) or cross (✗) per cell. First column highlighted with `--color-primary-light` background.
Take Playwright screenshot. Verify table is readable and highlighted column is visible.
